$schema_note: DentalCraft marketing site tokens v1.0 (2026-10-31). Source of truth: dentalcraft-web.figcraft, variable collections 'Color' (mode Dark) and 'Dimension', text styles 'Web/*'. Values match brand/brand-tokens.json and docs/design/tokens.json. The site is dark-only in v1 (see site-spec.md, open issues). CSS custom property names follow the FigCraft variable paths: color/bg/canvas -> --color-bg-canvas.

meta.name: DentalCraft web
meta.concept: Arch & Shell, read as a shade guide on a lab bench: graphite surfaces, enamel text, curing amber for the one action, solid / half / dashed markers for exists / in progress / planned

canvas.use: Page background, Hero, Vision, Downloads, About sections

panel.use: Alternating sections (Presentation, Modules, Regulatory, Contact), notify form

raised.use: Platform card body, disabled button fill, active language segment, pressed secondary button

sunken.use: Disclaimer band, footer, video player, input fill, shade-tab handle, disclaimer boxes, core plate

subtle.use: Hairlines: header and band bottom border, ledger rows, stage rows, FAQ dividers, card outlines

strong.use: Interactive boundaries (secondary button, input, toggle), Planned dashed outlines, principle top rules

disabled.note: Disabled controls only (WCAG exempt); always paired with a lock icon and a status tag

amber.use: Primary button fill, video play button, the arch line in art. One amber action per viewport. Never on light backgrounds.

ring.use: 2px focus outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element

danger.use: Email field error border, icon and message

success.use: Email field success icon and message

h2.use: Sub-blocks (video, screenshots), platform names, regulatory callout (700)

h3.use: Principle titles, stage groups, module names, FAQ questions

small.use: Nav links, captions, microcopy, form label

mono-label.case: uppercase (CSS text-transform; keep sentence case in the source text)
mono-label.use: Rail labels, status tags, disclaimer band, video kicker, footer column labels

mono-code.use: Language switch (13), CORE label, platform codes (20/24)

grid.desktop: 12 columns, content 1280, gutter 24; rail = 3 columns (302), content = 9 columns (954)

sm.use: Buttons, inputs, tags, boxes, video player, screenshots

segment.use: Active language segment inside the switch

tab.use: Shade-tab shape only: platform cards and module tabs (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left)

radius.rule: No pills, no circles for controls. Round shapes appear only as status markers (10-14 px).

elevation.rule: No shadows. Depth comes from the surface steps sunken < canvas < panel < raised and from 1 px lines.

tablet.note: Header nav collapses to the menu button below 1200

motion.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> no transitions, no smooth scroll, video never autoplays

in_progress.marker: ring 1.5 px + left half filled, text/primary

status_markers.rule: Status is always marker shape + word, never colour alone. Dashed = intent / not started everywhere on the site (Planned tags, intent banners, video placeholder).
